system.description:
Once per round, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you with a ranged weapon attack, it makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC, using Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher, or is knocked Prone.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Felling Shot
activities.text: After a ranged weapon hit on a creature no more than one size larger: Fortitude save against your Class Save DC (Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher) or knocked Prone.
